entries.original: **Fork-bomb stopped.** A broken install could make the `omo` runtime wrapper call itself in an infinite loop — `wrapper → CLI → wrapper → …` — spawning thousands of wedged processes until memory ran out. Delegation now carries a one-hop sentinel and refuses to target a generated wrapper, so the chain can never recurse.
entries.translated: `non-negotiable line`의 범위를 `design-system` 게이트로 제한하고 `contract pins`를 강화함

entries.original: **Ledger no longer bloats.** Every steering entry used to embed the full plan four times, so `.omo/ulw-loop/ledger.jsonl` grew quadratically over a long run. Entries now store a compact snapshot of only the goals that changed — a real 189 KB entry dropped to **7.8 KB (~24× smaller)**, and reads/dedup stream the file instead of loading it all into memory.
entries.translated: 오래된 `7-section` 포인터를 정렬하고 `designpowers` 로드 조건을 통합함

entries.original: **No more stuck child processes.** The senpi `ulw-loop status` spawn no longer wedges on a full stderr pipe; it runs detached with a 30-second hard timeout.
Rename transition updates across package detection, plugin/config compatibility, and install surfaces.
entries.translated: `designpowers lane-c` 및 `a11y/debt` 스키마를 기본 프론트엔드 흐름에 통합함

entries.original: Install and publish workflow hardening, including safer release sequencing and package/install fixes.
entries.translated: 프론트엔드 신규(greenfield) 연구를 기록 가능한 산출물 계약으로 전환함
